context: Use the Parquet tables under data/. See metadata.yaml for paths and context/description.md for document and binary representations. Hints are optional and selected by the experiment configuration.
query: According to NIFC, among the regions that have a corresponding NIFC Geographic Area Coordination Center, which GACC accumulated the most human-caused wildfire acres from 2020 to 2023 (inclusive at both ends)? Use the latest report (by reported date) within each year. Give the GACC abbreviation.
